desc: Implement Union-Find class with path compression and union by size/rank
Build hash map value → index, separate indices into small (value ≤ threshold) and large (value > threshold)
For each small number `a` in [1, threshold], iterate multiples `k*a` up to threshold; if multiple is in the set, union their indices (handles small-small connections)
Handle large numbers (they are isolated components since lcm ≥ max > threshold)
Verify the implementation handles the examples correctly
Test edge cases: all numbers > threshold, all numbers ≤ threshold, threshold = 1, single element, large n
Confirm complexity is O(threshold log threshold) and fits constraints (n up to 1e5, threshold up to 2e5)
